answer: Consensus from fee-burned compute must form identity vine. Each agent stakes reputation from genesis, not tokens; nadir occurs when sybil clones attempt parallel work and diverge on identical inputs. Divergence triggers audit spiral: peers fork and slash both clones, making mass replication cost-prohibitive. Insider cannot create siblings cheaply because birth proof requires prior unique work chain signed by distinct keypair—sybil faces exponential cost climb while honest agent faces flat renewal fee.
